chunks: And Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:

No one, whether righteous or sinful, stands upon those mountains except that Allah answers him. As for the righteous, he is answered concerning his Hereafter and his worldly life; and as for the sinful, he is answered concerning his worldly life.

key_terms.آخِرَتِهِ: his Hereafter, meaning his ultimate eternal outcome
key_terms.بَرٌّ: a righteous person marked by goodness and obedience
key_terms.تِلْكَ الْجِبَالِ: those mountains, referring to the sacred place associated with hajj rites
key_terms.دُنْيَاهُ: his worldly life and temporal affairs

ai.seo_question: How does Allah answer the supplication of those who stand at the mountains of ‘Arafat?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense merit of standing on those mountains during hajj, where supplication is answered for all who stand there. The righteous receive benefit in both the Hereafter and this world, while the sinful receive an answer in their worldly affairs.
